name: Python Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Get the project code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install pytest
        run: python -m pip install pytest

      - name: Run automated tests
        run: python -m pytest -v
